violations.text: An employee was observed touching ready to eat food homemade tortillas with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Foods were recooked on flattop to a minimum of 184 degrees Fahrenheit. Prohibido el contacto con las manos descubiertas guidance document provided during time of inspection. Methods to handle ready-to-eat foods discussed with owner. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by various dishes and utensils. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Items were removed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Plywood was observed in various non-food contact surfaces such as frame for steam table, window frame area in kitchen and door frame leading to kitchen. Areas to be smooth, durable and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/03/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine (in basement) and quaternary ammonium (upstairs kitchen) sanitizing solutions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026
